verdict.rationale: Azure RBAC is documented as a fine-grained access management system built on Azure Resource Manager. The docs give a scoping example where one user manages VMs and another manages virtual networks within a subscription, which covers the fine-grained and resource-scoping parts of the story. The pack has nothing on conditional policies or how policy evaluation works. Missing for 10: condition-based policy evidence, documented policy evaluation logic (e.g., deny/allow precedence), detail on scope hierarchy, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
